data.title: 神尾观铃 · 榻榻米上的纯白羽翼
data.description: 夜风吹开虚掩的木格窗，月光洒满整张席面。观铃顺从地任由细带睡裙滑落至腰际，纤弱的脊背弓起优雅的弧度，在一次次深情的温柔占有中发出了如释重负的啼鸣。
data.location: quiet moonlit tatami room with sliding screen open to the ocean horizon
data.action: lying back on tatami mats as sheer nightgown slips down baring alabaster breasts, slender back arching in trembling, tearful ecstatic release
data.lighting: ethereal silver moonlight illuminating pure golden hair and glistening tears of pleasure
data.mood: celestial lovers union, tragic curse dissolving into pure bliss, transcendent romantic catharsis
data.promptProse: Illuminated by celestial silver moonlight on the tatami, Misuzu arches her back with fallen nightgown, crying tears of sheer ecstatic love.
data.animaCaption: Misuzu bathed in silver moonlight on tatami, surrendered to radiant love.
